body: Quick pass: the branch merges cleanly onto its parent #3999 (stacked, it may show conflicts against main until the parent merges - the merge order is #3999, then this). The gate is green on the final head: the camcraft-ui lib suite (1654 passed, 0 failed, 8 release-lane ignores), the mcp_rotary_flow binary, clippy -D warnings on camcraft-ui and camcraft-app, and cargo xtask icons --check with 0 breaches. The body names the pins, the readings, the icon provenance and the before/after screenshots, which also cover review item 1 of #4005. Reviewed by the author's quick pass only; the independent review follows.

Clean review. No blocking findings. The PR merges cleanly with main.

I reviewed the full diff against current upstream rules. I tested the local trial merge with upstream/main `baad348f191a5f2261dc778ac3f9853aaf19ffa0`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

The stated-axis and retract controls edit the draft. Apply uses the existing undoable command. The new tests check Apply and undo. The MCP test checks listing, creation, parameter edits, chain picks, and refusal of face and vertex picks. I inspected the linked before/after screenshots on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The icon has original-art provenance.

### Local build and tests

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: build passed. The MCP suite passed (1 test). All eight selected UI integration suites passed: `boundary` (3), `boundary_picks` (7), `contour_dxf_sketch` (2), `sinker_setup` (2), `tap_hand` (3), `theme_example` (3), `theme_files` (17), and `waterjet_tool` (1).
- UI library: 1664 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored. All four new UI tests passed.
- Bare upstream/main comparison, same `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` suite: 1660 passed, the same 7 failed, 8 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask icons --check`: passed, 0 breaches.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed.

This headless host has no available GPU adapter. Six `egui_app::report_tests` fail with:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The affected tests are `a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`, `no_answer_copies_nothing`, `the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`, `the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`, `the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`, and `the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`.

`egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` fails with `egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter`. The same tests fail for the same reasons on bare main. These host failures do not block the PR.

### Extra suites run

`cargo xtask gate light`: 11 tests passed, 0 failed. All six steps passed: release build, motion library (7), `adaptive_troch_island` (1), `adaptive_troch_neck` (1), `adaptive_troch_parallel` (1), and app `pocket_pass_start` (1).

The diff changes no fixture directory, importer, post, operation generator, motion code, or catalog. The extra fixture, importer, and example-catalog rules do not select more suites.

Mutations: not applicable to this UI-only change. The diff changes no geometry, simulation, collision check, gouge check, or posted G-code logic. No recorded program or golden changed. Full heavy lanes were not run, per current upstream rules.

Requested before merge: none. Feature merge timing remains subject to the cut rules.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
